$Comment: Pushing a boss fight into one of its phases. Target is the encounter SCRIPT id (the file name under Server/EncounterManager); Qualifier is the phase's own state name exactly as the script signals it (zc:phase:<State>), so {"Kind": "ENCOUNTER_PHASE", "Target": "Zc_Encounter_Example", "Qualifier": "Phase_2", "Amount": 1} is met the first time that fight reaches Phase_2 with the player in it. Fires once per live member on every phase beat, whether or not they have dealt damage yet, because a member who is still in the fight is still part of it; Amount is 1 per beat. Leave Qualifier out to count every phase, and Target empty to count any boss.
